brief:
Settlers set fire to a residential house in Khallet al-Fara, a village located south of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, according to the Ma'an news agency. The arson attack destroyed the structure, adding to a pattern of property damage inflicted on Palestinian communities in the region.

Khallet al-Fara has faced repeated incidents of settler violence. The attack comes amid ongoing tensions between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers operating in areas of the West Bank, where such incidents have become increasingly common. Authorities have documented numerous cases of homes, vehicles, and agricultural land targeted by settlers in recent months.
title: Settlers torch home in southern Hebrat village
